CustomField.description: 内部制御用(死案件セットの一元管理)。紐づく譲渡案件(Sell/Sell_New)のフェーズが 成約/案件終了/On Hold/Converted to Buyer のいずれか=「死んだ案件」なら true。DealConflict自動化の各Getで「生きている」判定(=Deal_Is_Dead=false)に使用。死案件セットを変える時はこの数式1つを直せばよい。
CustomField.formula: OR( Sell_StageName__c = "成約", Sell_StageName__c = "案件終了", Sell_StageName__c = "On Hold", Sell_StageName__c = "Converted to Buyer", Sell_StageName_New__c = "成約", Sell_StageName_New__c = "案件終了", Sell_StageName_New__c = "On Hold", Sell_StageName_New__c = "Converted to Buyer" )
CustomField.label: 案件が終了(死案件)
